sources.title: OpenSakura · GitHub
sources.snippet: OpenSakura grew out of the SakuraLLM community — the pioneering open-source project for Japanese-to-Chinese ACGN translation models. Members of that community came together to push the mission further: broader language pairs, rigorous reproducibility, public benchmarks, and a more open development process.
